items.title: Fix invalid or incomplete task annotation headers
items.context: cli-validate reports 10 errors: missing @changes in observability/story-authority files and invalid @type test in observability smoke task annotations. Update only the required annotation metadata, not runtime behavior.
items.userSees: Terminal no longer prints the previous 10 ERROR lines for observability/story-authority task annotations.

happy.desc: All files previously reported by cli-validate have validator-compliant @task headers with required @changes fields.

edge.desc: Smoke task annotations use validator-accepted @type values without weakening or editing the validator.

adversarial.desc: The patch does not modify runtime code below the annotation headers.

items.title: Verify annotation validator and convergence output
items.context: Run node packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-validate.js and node bin/lattice.js convergence_check to prove the 10 annotation errors are gone and the code annotation compliance row passes.
items.userSees: convergence_check prints code annotation compliance as passed, not detail: 10 annotation errors.

happy.desc: node packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-validate.js exits 0 and prints PASSED: All task annotations are valid.

edge.desc: node bin/lattice.js convergence_check shows the code annotation compliance row passed.

adversarial.desc: convergence_check has no remaining false row caused by annotation errors after this patch.
